verdict.rationale: Sentry's AI agent monitoring captures and compares prompts in LLM-call telemetry. Prompt management is a fair axis for an LLM observability product, but nothing in the evidence shows prompt versioning, a prompt registry, or deploying prompt changes to production without shipping code. Comparing captured prompts in traces is an adjacent observability feature, not prompt management.

support.subject: As a developer, I can version prompts and deploy changes to production without shipping code
